name: use-overflow-fold
title: useOverflowFold
description: Measured fold — decide whether a row (tabs, saved views) fits the room it is given, and fold it into one control when it does not, with hysteresis so it never flickers.

meta.whenToUse: A row that should become one dropdown when it does not fit its container — scope tabs, route tabs, saved views.
meta.whenNotToUse: Truncating one piece of text (useOverflow, TruncatedText) or a layout CSS container queries can express.
